FAQS.TITLE: Prepare for Your Jungle Journey: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQS.DESCRIPTION: Everything you need to know before diving into the Maya jungle. We’ve gathered the most common questions to ensure your cenote adventure is seamless and unforgettable.

FAQS.question: What is a cenote and why is it special to explore in Cancun?
FAQS.answer: A cenote is a natural sinkhole filled with freshwater, formed by the collapse of limestone bedrock. In Cancun and the Riviera Maya, cenotes are unique because they connect to underground rivers and offer crystal-clear waters perfect for swimming, snorkeling, and diving. They also hold cultural significance in the ancient Mayan civilization.

FAQS.question: Do I need to be an experienced swimmer to enjoy a cenote adventure?
FAQS.answer: No, you don’t need advanced swimming skills. Cenote adventures are suitable for all levels. Life jackets are provided, and shallow areas are available for beginners. Guides are always present to ensure safety and comfort for every visitor.

FAQS.question: What should I bring for a cenote adventure in Cancun?
FAQS.answer: We recommend bringing a swimsuit, biodegradable sunscreen, a towel, and water shoes for comfort. Since most tours provide helmets, life jackets, and snorkeling gear, you only need to pack essentials to enjoy your cenote experience.

FAQS.question: Are cenote tours in Cancun family-friendly?
FAQS.answer: Yes, cenote adventures are family-friendly and suitable for children, teens, and adults. With guided tours, safe swimming areas, and kid-sized life jackets, families can explore these natural wonders together while enjoying a fun and educational experience.

CAMERAS.TITLE: Use of cameras policy
CAMERAS.P1: Based on international safety standards and ensuring the physical safety of visitors, cameras are not permitted during our adventure activities. Our activities require that your hands are free at all times. This includes cameras such as “point and shoot”, DSLR and SLR cameras, disposable cameras and cell phones.
CAMERAS.EXCEPTIONS_P: Go Pro Cameras and its alike are only permited if they are mounted on the helmet with a head mount during activities. The use of action selfie sticks, chest mounts, hand or any other body part other than head ( helmet)is prohibited.

CANCELLATION.TITLE: Cancellation Policy
CANCELLATION.P1: 100% refund if cancelacion is made 72 hours prior to activity date. 50% refund if cancelation is made 48 hours prior to activity date. 0% refund if cancelation is made 24hours or less prior to activity date.
CANCELLATION.NO_SHOW_P: Please be at least 5 min. before confirmed pickup time , transportación will have a 5 mins. Max of waiting torlerance. In case of no show amount charged is in no case refundable.

CLIMATE.TITLE: Climate Guarantee
CLIMATE.P1: Sometimes activties have to be canceled due to extreme weather conditions, your activity will be rescheduled for a different day , if thats not possible due to your vacation plan, you will recibe a 100% refund. Extreme Adventuring is the only one that can cancel because of weather conditions! Clients canceling because of climate generates a 100% cancelation fee.
